item.title: The top-down action Game, Tackle for Loss, is now available via Steam
item.description: "Indie developer Indifferent Penguin is proud to announce that American Football-infused top-down action game Tackle for Loss is out now on PC." - Indifferent Penguin.

item.title: The free online Steampunk ARPG, Crystalfall, is coming to Steam EA in March
item.description: "CRG Studio has announced that Crystalfall, its upcoming free online steampunk action RPG, will launch into Early Access in March 2026." - CRG Studio.

item.title: The highly anticipated indie Metroidvania, Constance, is coming to the Switch on May 1st
item.description: "Blue Backpack, ByteRockers Games and PARCO GAMES today announced that their highly anticipated indie Metroidvania, Constance, is coming to the Switch on May 1st." - Blue Backpack, ByteRockers Games and PARCO GAMES.

item.title: The 100-versus-100 shooter, Over The Top: WWI, is coming to Steam on March 6th
item.description: "Over The Top: WWI. The 100-versus-100 shooter from developer Flying Squirrel Entertainment and GG Publishing will be released on Steam for PC on March 6, 2026." - Flying Squirrel Entertainment and GG Publishing.

item.title: Ustwo Games makes layoffs to facilitate 'PC-first' pivot
item.description: The UK studio has made four people redundant.

item.title: Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.0 Launches February 13 With a New World and New Characters
item.description: Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.0 launches February 13, introducing Planarcadia, new companions, and a year-long story focused on Elation.

item.title: Square Enix announce Paranormasight: The Mermaid's Curse
item.description: The Mermaid's Curse trades the first Paranormasight's dingy streets for summery coastlines full of awful fish creatures.

item.title: Highguard | Episode 2 Patch NotesLaunching Feb 6
item.description: Episode 2 is on the horizon and with it comes our first new Warden, new map, Ranked Mode, and a whole bunch more!

item.title: RE Requiem Is Receiving The Strongest Purchase Intent After GTA 6 Of All Upcoming Releases In The US
item.description: Capcom's Resident Evil Requiem is receiving the strongest purchase intent after GTA VI of all the upcoming releases in the US.

item.title: Dark Quest: Remastered is Now Available on Consoles and PC
item.description: For the first time in the series' history, Dark Quest has arrived on consoles as Dark Quest: Remastered; free PC upgrade available for existing owners.
